title: Optimized immunofluorescence staining protocol to detect the nucleoporin Nup98 in different subcellular compartments
protocol: Fix HeLa cells on poly-lysine coated coverslips in methanol/acetone (1:1 vol/vol) for 30 min at -20°C.
Dry the fixed cells for 15 min and rehydrate with PBS for 15 min.
Block non-specific binding sites with PBS containing 2 mg/ml BSA for 1 h.
Incubate overnight with anti-Nup98 (0.5 μg/ml) in blocking solution.
Wash three times for 10 min each with PBS/2 mg/ml BSA after overnight incubation.
Incubate for 2 h with secondary antibodies (2 μg/ml) in blocking solution.
Wash three times for 10 min each in blocking solution; then incubate with DAPI (1 μg/ml) in blocking solution for 2 min.
Mount specimen in Vectashield and seal with nail polish.
Wash HeLa cells once with PBS at room temperature and fix with 3.7% formaldehyde in PBS for 25 min.
Rinse fixed cells with PBS, then permeabilize with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS/2 mg/ml BSA/1 mM NaN₃ for 5 min.
Block with 0.05% Tween 20 in PBS/2 mg/ml BSA/1 mM NaN₃ (blocking solution) for 1 h.
Incubate overnight with anti-Nup98 (0.5 μg/ml) in blocking solution.
Wash three times for 10 min each with blocking solution after overnight incubation.
Incubate for 2 h with secondary antibodies (2 μg/ml) in blocking solution.
Wash specimen three times for 10 minutes with blocking solution.
Incubate with 1 μg/ml DAPI in blocking solution for 2 minutes.
Mount specimen in Vectashield and seal with nail polish.
Wash once with PBS.
Fix with 4% formaldehyde in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse with PBS.
Permeabilize with PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/2 mg/ml BSA/1 mM NaN₃ on ice for 10 minutes.
Block with PBS/0.02% Triton X-100/3% BSA/1 mM NaN₃ (blocking solution) for 30 minutes.
Incubate with anti-Nup98 (2 μg/ml) in blocking solution for 30 minutes.
Wash four times with PBS/0.02% Triton X-100/1.5% BSA/1 mM NaN₃.
Incubate with secondary antibodies (20 μg/ml) in blocking solution for 30 minutes.
Wash four times with PBS/0.02% Triton X-100/1.5% BSA/1 mM NaN₃.
Incubate with 1 μg/ml DAPI in washing solution for 2 minutes.
Mount specimen in Vectashield and seal with nail polish.
Process images with appropriate software such as Adobe Photoshop 8.0.
